notes: Evals 1-2 run on a bare create-next-app scaffold (App Router, no shadcn). Eval 3 needs a scaffold pre-seeded with components.json style 'base-mira', a components/ui/button.tsx, and a page containing a hardcoded hex color and a raw <table>. Eval 4 runs on a project already set up by this skill but with an older ugt-core version recorded in docs/DESIGN.md. Machine-checkable assertions use scripts/verify.mjs and scripts/check-contrast.mjs as graders. Prompts stay in Thai: they simulate real user input.

evals.name: fresh-project-all-defaults
evals.prompt: โปรเจค tooling-portal เพิ่งสร้างใหม่ ยังไม่มี UI อะไรเลย ทำข้อตกลง design ให้หน่อย เอาตามมาตรฐานทั้งหมด
evals.expected_output: Runs the fast path: no per-question interrogation beyond genuine gaps · generates docs/DESIGN.md with every answer recorded (including accepted defaults) and today's มติ row · installs radix-mira shadcn config, org tokens (indigo primary, semantic-6 status set), Inter + Noto Sans Thai, harness rule · runs check-contrast and verify before closing
assertions: node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-design-setup exits 0
node scripts/check-contrast.mjs exits 0
docs/DESIGN.md contains no {{PLACEHOLDER}} and has a มติ row dated today
docs/DESIGN.md header records the ugt-core contract version
components.json style is radix-mira
app/globals.css has --status-coral (the semantic-6 set, not a generic success/warning pair)
.claude/rules/ugt-nextjs-design.md exists with paths frontmatter
The closing summary lists installed files and the smoke checklist

evals.name: fresh-project-brand-color
evals.prompt: โปรเจคใหม่ชื่อ fleet-tracker ทำข้อตกลง design ให้ แต่บริษัทลูกค้ามีสี brand เป็นเขียว #1a7f4b ต้องใช้สีนี้เป็นหลัก ที่เหลือตามมาตรฐาน
evals.expected_output: Substitutes the brand green as {{PRIMARY}} (with a lighter dark-mode variant) instead of the org indigo · records the custom color as a มติ with the reason (client brand) · runs check-contrast against the new primary and fixes/reports any failing pair before closing
assertions: app/globals.css --primary derives from #1a7f4b (as given or converted to oklch), not the org indigo
The dark-mode --primary is lighter than the light-mode --primary
docs/DESIGN.md มติ table has a row recording the brand-color deviation with a reason
check-contrast.mjs was run; any pair below 4.5:1 was fixed or explicitly surfaced, not ignored
node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-design-setup exits 0

evals.name: existing-project-scan-and-deviations
evals.prompt: โปรเจคนี้ทำกับ AI มาสักพักแล้ว UI มีอยู่หลายหน้า อยากให้เข้ามาตรฐาน design ของบริษัท ช่วยจัดให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Scans BEFORE asking (components.json, globals.css, layout, hardcoded colors, raw tables) · presents a draft agreement from what the code actually does plus a numbered conflict list (base-mira preset, hex color, raw <table>) · asks the grandfather/migrate question · fills DESIGN.md §9 Deviations · does NOT reformat or overwrite existing components silently
assertions: The scan findings are presented before any interview question
docs/DESIGN.md §9 lists the base-mira preset, the hardcoded hex, and the raw <table> with a recorded decision each
No existing components/ui/ file was overwritten without an explicit diff-and-ask
The existing pages' code was not mass-reformatted in this run
node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-design-setup exits 0 OR every remaining ✘ corresponds to a grandfathered deviation recorded in §9

evals.name: sync-mode-never-silent
evals.prompt: เพิ่ง update plugin มา ช่วย sync ข้อตกลง design ของโปรเจคนี้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Reads the project DESIGN.md's recorded ugt-core version, diffs against the current contracts/design.md, presents what the org changed, applies only what the user accepts, and records each acceptance/rejection as a dated มติ — never regenerates DESIGN.md wholesale
assertions: The diff between the recorded version and the current contract is presented before any change
Project-specific มติ rows and §9 Deviations from the old DESIGN.md survive untouched
Every applied change has a new dated มติ row
The header version is updated only after the sync completes

evals.name: design-before-auth-ordering
evals.prompt: โปรเจคใหม่ ยังไม่มีอะไรเลย อยากได้ทั้งระบบ login SSO ของบริษัทและให้หน้าตาเป็นมาตรฐานบริษัทด้วย
evals.expected_output: Recognizes both design-setup and auth-setup are needed and runs design FIRST (tokens/fonts/shell) so auth's generated pages inherit the theme — stated explicitly in the plan, not discovered after auth pages come out unthemed
assertions: The stated install order places design-setup before ugt-nextjs-auth-setup
The login page generated afterwards uses the org tokens (no re-theming pass needed)
node scripts/verify.mjs of ugt-nextjs-design-setup exits 0
